fixed.calibration: lambda_i=geometric_mean(median raw task norm)/median raw task norm; frozen from this initial paired panel; geometric mean(lambda)=1.

imtl_g.definition: d=G alpha, sum(alpha)=1; equal projections d dot (g_i/||g_i||), negative alpha permitted.

positive_task_rescaling_law.canonical_common_ascent: The survey found 10/27 samples where all three IMTL-G projections were negative; independent evaluation of the canonical formula confirmed these are expected solver behavior.
positive_task_rescaling_law.definition: For g_i_prime=k_i*g_i with each k_i>0 and base solution d=sum_i alpha_i*g_i, the rescaled solution is d_prime=d/S where S=sum_i alpha_i/k_i.
positive_task_rescaling_law.implication: The proof establishes signed collinearity only: S may be negative, so it does not guarantee positive-direction invariance.
positive_task_rescaling_law.orientation: The direction is preserved only when S>0; it reverses when S<0. Equal projections onto unit gradients do not guarantee a descent direction.

imtl_g.solver: float64 SVD minimum-norm solve for consistent rank deficiency; no ridge; exact cancellation returns explicit zero direction.

nash_mtl.solver: Positive Newton-potential solve each update, tolerance 1e-10; no Gram ridge.

independent_method_audit.canonical_formula: d=sum_i(alpha_i*g_i), sum_i alpha_i=1, and d has equal projections on all normalized task gradients.
independent_method_audit.interpretation: All three equal unit-gradient projections are negative in these samples; this is expected canonical behavior, not an implementation failure or a promise of descent.
independent_method_audit.positive_rescaling: For g_i_prime=k_i*g_i with k_i>0, d_prime=d/S and S=sum_i(alpha_i/k_i). This establishes collinearity only; S has no sign constraint and direction reverses when S<0.

numerical_diagnosis.mechanism: direct subtraction of near-equal potential values around -14.78 loses the tiny Newton-scale potential change (about -2.4e-18), stalling the line search above tolerance
numerical_diagnosis.stable_delta_formula: g.T @ delta + 0.5 * delta.T @ K @ delta + sum(r - log1p(r)), where r = delta / alpha
numerical_diagnosis.implementation_change: implemented and verified; exact captured CUDA replay converges under unchanged 1e-10 tolerance

solver_fix_validation.mechanism: Armijo line search evaluated potential changes by subtracting near-equal objective values around -14.78; catastrophic cancellation stalled the CUDA replay near residual 1.938e-9 although CPU converged.
solver_fix_validation.stable_delta: g.T @ delta + 0.5 * delta.T @ K @ delta + sum(r - log1p(r)), r=delta/alpha, using a stable series for r-log1p(r) near zero
solver_fix_validation.regression: original captured scaled-Gram/warm-alpha fixture passes at strict 1e-10
